case_title: SAAR CONSTRUCTION DBA BMP VS PAN, ROGER PANCO DEVELOPMENT INC.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,950.00 FILED BY SAAR CONSTRUCTION DBA BMP AS TO DEFENDANT PAN, ROGER PANCO DEVELOPMENT INC. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-01-1997 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT C
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT PAN, ROGER PANCO DEVELOPMENT INC.
DEF. REQUEST FOR A CONTINUANCE TO BE SIGNED BY JUDGE,DATE REQUESTED IS MAY 12,1997 03:30 PM.
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION MAY-01-1997, CONTINUANCE ORDERED PER REQUEST TO MAY-12-1997 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT C
CLAIM OF DEFENDANT FOR $2,950.00 FILED BY PAN, ROGER PANCO DEVELOPMENT INC. AS TO CROSS DEFENDANT SAAR CONSTRUCTION DBA BMP ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-12-1997 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT C

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SAAR CONSTRUCTION DBA BMP RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PAN, ROGER PANCO DEVELOPMENT INC. $2,950.00 PRINCIPAL, $40.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,990.00, IN THE EVENT THAT DEFENDANT ESTABLISHES THAT ITS CHECK #1937 FOR $1450 (DATED 3/13/95) WAS PAID TO STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT CROSS COMPLAINANT PAN, ROGER PANCO DEVELOPMENT INC. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY CROSS DEFENDANT SAAR CONSTRUCTION DBA BMP PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT PAN, ROGER PANCO DEVELOPMENT INC.
